title: Clarity changes your world. Shared clarity changes the Yuga.
personal: Once you clearly understand that we are the same Creator experiencing this game, the world completely changes for you. When this truth becomes clear to humanity, the Yuga itself changes. When only a few remember, it is Kali Yuga. As more awaken, it shifts into Dwapara Yuga, then Treta Yuga, and finally Satya Yuga when our shared identity is widely realized and lived.
vision: Satya Yuga means the age of truth: a wonderful world rich in culture, happiness, wellbeing, creative expression, and peace, without corruption. In this understanding, the Yugas express how widely the truth of our shared identity is realized and lived. The movement toward that world unfolds naturally as more minds awaken from within the game.
